incidents.what: POST /products returned 503 "Server is busy or restarting. Please retry in a few seconds." (clean JSON 503 from the Worker); UI showed the banner, exactly 1 POST was sent, no product was created. Re-run of T3 passed. Environment, not a product defect.

The duplicate-SKU create through the UI returned the Worker 503 "Server is busy or restarting" three times in a row (all 1 POST, nothing saved); the identical request body replayed directly via the API and a later UI attempt both returned 201 in ~2-4 s. Treated as a transient backend/container availability problem during that window, not a SKU rule.
